result.note: Tests the CAFE-III fuel-economy norms notified by the Ministry of Power: their period, target tightening and the dual test procedures.

questions.prompt: In September 2026, the Ministry of Power notified the Corporate Average Fuel Economy (CAFE)-III norms for passenger cars. Consider the following statements about them:
items: They apply from April 2027 to March 2032 and tighten fleet targets by 16.7 per cent over the period.
The UN-developed Worldwide Harmonised Light Vehicles Test Procedure (WLTP) is stricter than India's Modified Indian Driving Cycle (MIDC).
The factor for converting targets between the MIDC and WLTP tests was notified along with the norms.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 3 is wrong because the conversion factor between the two tests has yet to be notified. From April 2027, carmakers must report results under both the MIDC, India's standard fuel-economy test, and the stricter WLTP.
questions.source: The rules apply from April 1, 2027, to March 31, 2032, and tighten fleet targets by 16.7 per cent over the period.
